title: A session an Assistant opens joins the grid on screen when that grid already shows its project

requirements.text: With a grid on screen that shows project P, a session an Assistant opens in P appears as a pane beside P's other panes without a refresh
requirements.check: manual: relaunch, open P's grid, ask P's Assistant to open a session

requirements.text: With one session on screen, a session an Assistant opens stays in the background and the screen does not change
requirements.check: manual: single session view, ask the Assistant to open one

requirements.text: The app builds and swift test passes

evidence: swift build -> Build complete! (22.65s); swift test 135/0

text: joinGridIfShowing in AppModel: Assistant-opened session inserted after its project's last pane when a grid (count>1) already shows that project; single view untouched. Builds, tests pass. Left: TJ relaunch + eye reqs 1-2. Not committed.
